role: DeviceRecordingSession extension implementing H10/Verity Sense internal (device) recording: start, stop+download, and the single assembly path (Stop/Retry/Recover) that places downloaded beats on a session clock, backs them up, merges with an archived night, analyses with HealthKit sleep and training load, scores, saves for review and publishes acceptance state.
types: DeviceRecordingSession.SleepBoundaryContext: struct — HealthKit sleep start/wake/segments in session ms
DeviceRecordingSession.DownloadPlacement: struct — session id/type/start/provenance/existing archived night a download is filed under
DeviceRecordingSession.DeviceAnalysisOutcome: struct — analysis result, artifact flags, verification, window
DeviceRecordingSession.AssemblyOutcome: struct (private) — analysis + sleep context + data-source summary

units.does: Starts a device-internal recording: requires a connected strap, refreshes the strap's own recording status, refuses if already recording or the new id exists, starts the strap recording, publishes the session as collecting (phase .deviceRecording), then persists the recording marker, which records that phase.

branches.cond: strap reports it is already recording
reconciliation already knows the new session id

units.does: Builds a DeviceProvenance for the connected strap (id or 'unknown', model display name or 'Polar device', mode deviceInternal).
Publishes a started device recording: currentSession, empty collectedPoints, sessionStartTime, isCollecting = true, phase .deviceRecording.

Stop (and Retry): requires connection, resolves the session the recording belongs to, downloads the strap recording made since its start (attended budget), and assembles it; a failed download yields a failed session.

branches.effect: failed session built from a new HRVSession() (fresh id, start now)

units.does: Decides where a downloaded recording is filed: the resolved base session's id/type/start/provenance, merging with that id's archived copy when the archive holds one (an archived placeholder night, as Recover merges); or (no base) a new overnight dated by the recording's own start.

branches.effect: new UUID overnight placement dated by recordingStart
existing = the archived copy (its beats fill gaps, its metadata carries forward); else nil

units.does: Single assembly for downloaded beats: places them on the placement clock, raw-backs them up, fails with insufficientData below DataSourceSelector.minimumValidBeats, merges with any archived night, analyses/assembles, and archives for review when the id is not already archived.

branches.effect: continues; otherwise returns a failed session (beats still backed up)

branches.cond: archive does not yet hold this id
branches.effect: archiveForReview (which itself only saves .complete); an existing night is replaced only on Accept

units.does: Merges device beats with the existing archived night (rebased onto the placement clock) via DataSourceSelector when there is one; returns points and a DataSourceSummary.

Builds the DataSourceSummary: device/archived/total beat counts, percent difference when there was an archived stream, reconnectCount and device model carried from the existing night or the connected strap.

branches.effect: connected strap's display name (nil if disconnected)

units.does: Runs artifact detection, verification, HealthKit sleep context, training load fetch, window selection and analysis, then assembles the final session.

branches.effect: recordingEnd = now (endDate is always set by beginAnalyzingSession)

units.does: Creates the .analyzing session (end = last beat time, placement provenance) and publishes it as currentSession.
Returns series start + last.endMs (the beats are on the session's clock, so a recording armed after the session began ends later by the gap), capped at now; now when the series is empty.

Resolves the session a device recording belongs to: the current session, else the persisted recording marker, else a single unresolved overnight placeholder from the archive in the last 24 h; else nil.

branches.effect: returns it (whatever its state, e.g. a previous failed session on Retry)
returns a .collecting session with its id/start/type
returns it; otherwise logs and returns nil

units.does: Builds a .collecting HRVSession from the persisted (id, start, type) tuple, no provenance.
Finds exactly one recent (24 h) overnight archive entry that looks unresolved (no meanRMSSD or score <= 1.0) and loads it; refuses when there are several.
Entry predicate: overnight, dated at/after cutoff, and either no meanRMSSD or recoveryScore <= 1.0.

branches.cond: not overnight or older than cutoff

units.does: Start date for a recording with no app-known session: its own startedAt, else HealthKit sleep start minus the beats' detected sleep onset, else now minus its duration.

branches.effect: returns it; otherwise dates back from now

units.does: Fetches HealthKit sleep over the last 24 h (with the beats for onset detection) and returns sleep start minus the beats' sleep-onset offset; nil when HealthKit has no sleep start or the fetch throws.

branches.cond: fetch failed (try? → nil) or sleepStart nil

units.does: Builds a .failed session (same id/start/type/device provenance, end now, no data), publishes it as currentSession and sets lastError.
Writes the points to RawRRBackup under the session id with device id and capture date; errors logged only.
Fetches HealthKit sleep for the recording span and converts sleep start/end and (split nights) segments to session-relative ms.

branches.effect: logs and returns an empty context (window selection without sleep bounds)

units.does: Maps SleepData.segments to session-relative SleepSegmentMs (fallback 0 for invalid offsets).
When training-load integration is enabled, fetches the morning-reading training load from HealthKit into collector.cachedTrainingLoad.

branches.effect: logs; the value is always non-nil after assignment

units.does: Analyses with the recovery window when found, else the whole session with peak capacity, else the whole session.

branches.cond: window result with a recovery window

branches.effect: full-session analysis with peak capacity; nil result → plain full analysis

units.does: Builds the final session (complete if analysed else failed) with clamped sleep bounds, segments and data-source summary; carries archived metadata, applies recovery score, freezes training snapshot and publishes acceptance state.
Copies tags, notes, provenance, links, sleep/vitals/training snapshots and sleepUserAdjusted from the archived night onto the recovered one.
Freezes the training snapshot as of the night's end if none, and stamps it into analysisResult.trainingContext.

branches.effect: creates one relative to end (or start)

units.does: Computes the composite recovery score; stores score and breakdown, and for overnight sessions also the sleep/vitals snapshots used.

Publishes acceptance: currentSession, verification, recovery window, needsAcceptance (complete only), phase .awaitingAcceptance when complete, baseline deviation, clears sessionStartTime and bumps archive signal.

branches.effect: phase → .awaitingAcceptance; a failed analysis leaves phase as it was (e.g. .deviceRecording until the binding flips it)

units.does: A .collecting HRVSession for the placement (id, start, type, provenance) used as the base of an insufficient-data failure.
File-scope: logs the ambiguous archive candidates (up to 5).

branches.cond: for each of the first 5 candidates
